notes.title: FFC v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue regarding the PDA sometimes not activating properly
All wallpapers should now save properly
The pool water/lights should now show up properly in accordance with player progress
Remi should no longer exclusively path into vents, but should wander around a little more now
Fixed an issue where sometimes if the player stunned a girl just as she grabbed them, they'd be permanently stuck until another girl came around
Fixed an issue regarding Charlie+Baylee at the player hideout
Fixed an issue regarding swapping between the PDA and the taser causing a black screen
Suite 69 should now properly reset enemy difficulty between plays
Reworded some achievements to make their goals clearer/changed one entirely
Fixed an issue with Remi's scenes
Fixed an issue with certain hideout upgrades not displaying in the shop correctly
Fixed an issue where the language selector wasn't working properly
Several other smaller fixes/changes

As always, thank you all for your continued support. If you find any bugs, please let me know at lovebites.direct@gmail.com
- glass
